reader_summary.overview: In this episode of PortfolioCasts | Investor Portfolio Podcasts, we analyze the portfolio of Chase Coleman, founder of Tiger Global Management. Known for its high-growth and tech-heavy strategy, Tiger Global’s portfolio features a mix of established giants and emerging innovators. Holdings covered include:MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, META, GOOGL, SE, RDDT, TSM, UBER, DASH, NFLX, WDAY, AVGO, SPOT, NOW, MDB, ZS, CPNG, GRAB, JD, and more.
